patterns.note: The page is structured as a series of full-width, high-contrast color blocks, each dedicated to a distinct content section (hero, portfolio, philosophy, skills, closing).
Extremely large, decorative serif typography is used as a primary visual element for section titles and the hero, often spanning multiple lines and dominating the visual space.
A limited, high-contrast color palette of vibrant orange/red, dark charcoal, and white is used consistently to define and separate content blocks.
Content sections reveal by scrolling into the viewport sequentially, with no complex scroll-triggered animations, parallax effects, or sticky elements.
Portfolio items are presented as a grid of image thumbnails with minimal text, emphasizing the visual nature of the work.

technique_notes: The site uses full-width content blocks with distinct background colors to segment information, creating clear visual breaks between sections.
Large, decorative serif fonts are employed as primary visual elements, often spanning multiple lines and contrasting sharply with the background color to create a bold statement.

Scrolling simply reveals the next full-width content block, with no complex scroll-triggered animations, parallax, or sticky elements; the design relies on static hierarchy and strong visual separation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized display headings (~5-8x body text) with a decorative serif, contrasted with small, legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with significant vertical padding between full-width content blocks, allowing large typography and sections to breathe.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold, almost brutalist use of oversized, decorative serif typography as primary visual elements. This, combined with a high-contrast, limited color palette and a direct, section-by-section scroll experience, makes it feel less like a traditional website and more like an interactive poster or a digital art book.
